title: Cardano DEX Protocol with DIDs Layer

・Design integration architecture for decentralized identity layer

Dear Reviewers,
We have now completed the beta testing and implemented all feature requests. The code is fully open-source and available at: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer.
In addition, we have written and released the testing report here: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer/blob/main/report/beta-testing.md. Furthermore, we have updated our README.md (https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer/blob/main/README.md) to reflect the latest changes. ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
We have continued our development work, and you can again find the repository here: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer. We extended the README with an additional user guide: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer/blob/main/README.md, and also added a guide explaining what our test cases cover and how to use them: https://github.com/MuesliSwapTeam/did-dex-layer/blob/main/TEST_USER_GUIDE.md.
Moreover, we prepared an initial launch strategy, which we compiled into a PDF document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/166QcECPrCFxUzUZlfzIv1FZifTI5GT44/view?usp=share_link.
Update: We rewrote some of the instructions in the README and fixed several scripts for better reproducibility. Moreover, we created an additional video explaining our DID order book contracts: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1HMivfdhfc0I5o187HRhsZYQ82NnvWffB/view?usp=sharing. Moreover, to address some of the concerns regarding the previously used minting website we have now added an additional minting script that treats the DID minting as a black box and helps to verify the correct usage of the DID NFTs in the orderbook. 
Thank you very much.
Best regards,
MuesliSwap Team

ms.report:
A. Output: Deployed DEX protocol: The protocol is successfully deployed on the Cardano blockchain, accessible for users and businesses to utilize for decentralized trading.
Evidence: We have developed a fully functional frontend for our DID DEX, which integrates with the implemented DID order book smart contracts and operates on the Cardano Preprod network. The application is available at: https://preprod.did-dex.muesliswap.com/. The frontend is supported by a backend service, which can be accessed here: https://preprod.did-dex-api.muesliswap.com/docs. 
For your convenience we have also created an additional walk-through video that demonstrates the interface: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mq16V4TZ6rRvxLvE1EHAXECt3BDn7mle/view?usp=sharing 
Additionally, we have prepared example transactions on the Preprod network for your convenience.

B. Output: Technical documentation: Detailed documentation that provides insights into the integration process, smart contract functionalities, and operational guidelines for developers.
Evidence: We have created a full technical documentation outlining all our design decisions, explanation about the codebase and trade-offs https://drive.google.com/file/d/1LfpeXjzzUgyuvI8nEh3P2OE3jJtogJ5y/view
